# harmoniq_environment (Resource)

An environment of a host app (e.g. `staging`, `production`), with an optional approval policy. Use either the `approval_policy` attribute here or a `harmoniq_approval_policy` resource for an environment, not both. Deleting is refused while it serves module versions.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "harmoniq_environment" "staging" {
  workspace = harmoniq_workspace.checkout_team.slug
  host_app  = harmoniq_host_app.storefront.slug
  slug      = "staging"
  name      = "Staging"
}

resource "harmoniq_environment" "production" {
  workspace  = harmoniq_workspace.checkout_team.slug
  host_app   = harmoniq_host_app.storefront.slug
  slug       = "production"
  name       = "Production"
  is_default = true

  approval_policy = {
    required_approvers    = 2
    eligible_roles        = ["admin", "owner"]
    require_change_ticket = true
    ticket_url_pattern    = "https://acme.atlassian.net/browse/{id}"
    expiry_hours          = 24
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `host_app` (String) Host app slug.
- `name` (String) Display name.
- `slug` (String) Environment slug; part of manifest URLs.
- `workspace` (String) Workspace slug.

### Optional

- `approval_policy` (Attributes) Changes to this environment need approval. Remove the block to drop the policy. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--approval_policy))
- `is_default` (Boolean) Make this the host app's default environment (the others stop being it). Can't be set to `false`: make another environment the default instead.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `workspace/host-app/slug`.

<a id="nestedatt--approval_policy"></a>
### Nested Schema for `approval_policy`

Required:

- `eligible_roles` (Set of String) Roles that may approve: `developer`, `admin`, `owner`.

Optional:

- `expiry_hours` (Number) Hours before a pending request expires (1–720, default 24).
- `require_change_ticket` (Boolean) Changes must carry a change ticket id.
- `required_approvers` (Number) Approvals needed (1–10, default 1). Requesters never approve their own changes.
- `ticket_url_pattern` (String) Link built from the ticket id, containing `{id}`, e.g. `https://acme.atlassian.net/browse/{id}`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import harmoniq_environment.production checkout-team/storefront/production
```
